items.title: Intuitive Initiative Squads & alignment
items.do: Start a combat with Aveline, Durgan, Ogre Chieftain, Orc Warrior, and 4 Goblin Sneaks, then open Initiative. Click enemy checkboxes, click "+ Squad" / "+ Add" (including on the bottom row), test Ungroup All → Auto-Squad Minions, and roll Initiative.
items.expect: Checkboxes have crisp high-contrast borders and checking them puts "Group Selected (N)" in the Enemies header with zero vertical layout shift; "+ Squad" / "+ Add" popovers open directly under their clicked button (floating cleanly over the window/footer without shifting position or growing the window); Orc Warrior's sub-line stays on one tidy row.

items.title: Demoralize ignores Cover Banes
items.do: Place Orc Warrior behind Low or Medium cover (e.g. an ally or corner) and have Sylwen or Grave Wisp use Demoralize on a target behind cover.
items.expect: No Cover Bane or High Cover Doomed is added to Demoralize (normal Strike / Ranged actions still take Cover Banes).

items.title: Lay On Hands @Rally target & damage card = icon
items.do: Have Durgan use Lay On Hands (2 AP) targeting Aveline and click the Rally Point button on the card while Durgan's token is still selected; also deal damage to Durgan and inspect the "=" breakdown button next to Undo.
items.expect: Clicking Lay On Hands' Rally Point opens "Rally: Aveline" (never Durgan) and heals Aveline; the "=" icon inside the breakdown button is dead-center inside its square border.

items.title: Daunted (EoT) expires at end of target's turn
items.do: Have Grave Wisp hit Durgan with Chilling Touch (applying Daunted EoT), then advance through Durgan's turn (including when Durgan is last in the round) into the next round.
items.expect: Daunted (Grave Wisp) (EoT) clears automatically at the end of Durgan's turn on both Round 1 and Round 2+.

items.title: Interrupt before Trigger & defeated tokens skip Reactions
items.do: Kill/defeat an enemy with a Reaction (e.g. Orc Warrior) and trigger its moment near its body; also trigger Slip Away (Kaela, Interrupt) and Rebuke (Aveline, Trigger) on the same enemy movement, and try reordering the stack.
items.expect: Defeated/Down tokens never trigger Reactions or post No-Reactions lines; Interrupt (Slip Away) is always listed and resolved before Trigger (Rebuke), and Rebuke cannot be moved above Slip Away. Also verify Skip Defeated is ON by default in Combat Tracker settings, dead squad Minions no longer trigger the Minion pick bar, and hovering across Combat Strip portraits never leaves stuck token highlights on the canvas.
